project.name: spark-mutation-testing-core
project.description:
Core state machine, deterministic hashing, mutation catalog and report writers. Pure Java 17.
ARCHITECTURAL INVARIANT: this module must contain ZERO Spark imports. It has no compile- or provided-scope dependency on any org.apache.spark artifact, and scripts/check_no_spark_imports.sh fails the build if an "import org.apache.spark" statement appears in src/main/java.
SessionResetFacade is the deliberate edge case: its logic is entirely Spark-specific but it is implemented purely via java.lang.reflect against an Object parameter, so no Spark type is ever named at compile time. That is why spark-sql appears below at TEST scope only: its unit test needs a real SparkSession to reflect against.
